title: ROTOR FORWARD SHAFT DOVETAIL CRACK
reason_for_revision: Minor updates to clarify root cause statement, clarify flared and unflared part applicability for AUL, and remove 7FB from application statement.
purpose: To inform users of the risk of cracking in the forward shaft dovetail region and to define inspection scope and intervals for specific unflared and flared configurations.
compliance_category_text: Alert - Failure to comply with the TIL could result in equipment damage or facility damage. Compliance is mandated within a specific operating time.
scope_of_work: Perform a dovetail ultrasonic (UT) inspection on any 7FA unit that has operated for any length of time with the specified hardware configurations (flared: uncambered IGV, standard R0 (snowflake) or p-cut R0, uniform S0/S1 vane spacing; unflared: uncambered IGV, standard R0 or p-cut R0).
Perform UT on all 32 wheel dovetail slots on both the pressure and suction side of the dovetail.
service_recommendation_line_items: For applicable 7FA configurations, perform dovetail ultrasonic (UT) inspection at 48,000 factored fired hours (hours-based units) or 900 factored fired starts (starts-based units).
If the unit has already exceeded its inspection interval, perform the inspection at the next interval according to the unit's operating profile (hours based or starts based).

If the compressor remains in the unenhanced configuration or with uniform S0/S1 vane spacing, perform reinspections at the specified inspection interval until the rotor maintenance interval is reached per GER 3620.

If upgraded to non-uniform S0/S1 vanes or an enhanced compressor package (package 2-5 for flared units, package 3-5 for unflared units), perform only one reinspection at the time of the upgrade; if the upgrade occurred prior to release of this TIL, perform only one inspection at the first interval outlined above.

Submit inspection results and the forward shaft serial number (located on the forward flange outside diameter of the shaft) to your GE Service Representative for review and additional recommendations.
maintenance_trigger_text: Inspection is recommended for any 7FA unit that has operated for any length of time with the specified hardware configurations; inspection timing is based on operating profile (hours-based or starts-based) and the inspection interval table.
recommended_interval_or_trigger: Hours based unit: 48,000 factored fired hours
Starts based unit: 900 factored fired starts
usage_counter_requirements_text: For a unit that has already exceeded its inspection interval, the inspection should occur at the next interval described above according to that unit's operating profile, either hours based or starts based.
frame_or_model_applicability_text: Select unflared 7FA units and all flared 7FA units originally shipped with uniform S0/S1 vanes and non-enhanced forward compressor hardware.
hardware_or_part_configuration_text: Applicable hardware configurations for inspection recommendation: Flared configuration: Uncambered IGV; Standard R0 (snowflake) or p-cut R0; Uniform S0/S1 vane spacing. Unflared configuration: Uncambered IGV; Standard R0 or p-cut R0. No inspections are recommended for any 7FA shipped new with non-uniform S0/S1 vane spacing (flared) or an enhanced compressor package 5.
exclusions_or_non_applicable_conditions_: No inspections are recommended for any 7FA shipped new with non-uniform S0/S1 vane spacing (flared) or an enhanced compressor package 5. 7FB units are not affected by this TIL.
prerequisite_outage_or_inspection_contex: Time to perform actual inspection is 2-3 hours with the rotor and IGV locked and tagged out.
sbom_trigger_reason: Applicability and inspection/reinspection requirements depend on installed hardware configuration (e.g., flared vs unflared, uniform vs non-uniform S0/S1 vane spacing, enhanced compressor package level, R0 type, IGV type).

parts_referenced.context: Ultrasonic tooling included as part of the standard R0 inspection kit.

reference_documents.context: Reinspections are recommended at the inspection interval specified above, until the rotor maintenance interval is reached per GER 3620.

configuration_variables: Forward compressor package (unenhanced vs enhanced; package 2-5 for flared units; package 3-5 for unflared units)
R0 type (standard R0 (snowflake), standard R0, or p-cut R0)
configuration_summary: Inspection applicability and reinspection frequency depend on whether the unit is flared or unflared and whether it has uncambered IGV, standard/p-cut R0, and uniform S0/S1 vane spacing, as well as whether it has been upgraded to non-uniform S0/S1 vanes or an enhanced compressor package.
failure_consequences: Operation with a crack increases the risk of R0 migration
Operation with a crack increases the risk of R0 and IGV clashing
Operation with a crack increases the risk of blade and wheel post liberation that could cause secondary damage to the gas turbine compressor
risk_summary: Cracks have been found on the pressure face of the wheel dovetail of the forward shaft; operation with a crack increases risk of R0 migration, R0 and IGV clashing, or blade and wheel post liberation causing secondary compressor damage.

tables_found_summary.table_description: Inspection interval by operating profile: hours-based vs starts-based units.
tables_found_summary.reason: Provides the specific inspection interval thresholds (48,000 factored fired hours; 900 factored fired starts) needed for outage scoping and scheduling.

missing_information_flags: No specific UT acceptance/rejection criteria or crack size/disposition guidance is provided (only that results should be submitted to GE for review).
No specific part numbers are provided for the 'standard R0 inspection kit' ultrasonic tooling or any replacement hardware (Parts section states N/A).
No explicit definition or method for calculating 'factored fired hours' or 'factored fired starts' is provided in the document text.

source_snippets.snippet: To inform users of the risk of cracking in the forward shaft dovetail region and to define inspection scope and intervals for specific unflared and flared configurations.
Select unflared 7FA units and all flared 7FA units originally shipped with uniform S0/S1 vanes and non-enhanced forward compressor hardware.
It is recommended to perform a dovetail ultrasonic (UT) inspection on any 7FA unit that has operated for any length of time with all of the below specified hardware:
The ultrasonic inspection should be performed on all 32 wheel dovetail slots on both the pressure and suction side of the dovetail.

Hours based unit 48,000 factored fired hours
Starts based unit 900 factored fired starts

If the compressor remains in the unenhanced configuration or with uniform S0/S1 vane spacing, reinspections are recommended at the inspection interval specified above, until the rotor maintenance interval is reached per GER 3620.

If a unit is upgraded to non-uniform S0/S1 vanes or an enhanced compressor package (package 2-5 for flared units,
package 3-5 for unflared units), then only one reinspection is necessary at the time of the upgrade.
